content: Doriyar farot sahabi okkolore Isaye deha diye
In okkol bade, Isaye Ṭaiberia doriyar farot abar nizore sahabi okkolore deha diye. Ar hibaye nizore endilla gori forhaš goijje.
Simon Fitor, Ṭomas (zare Didymus ḍaka oito,) Galilor Kana farar Natanael, Sebdeusor futain edde hibar oinno duizon sahabi, itara ekkui fũwati aššil.
Simon Fitore hitarare hodde, "Ãi mas doitto zair." Ar hitara hibare hodde, "Ãra o tũwar fũwati zai." Toi hitara bair oi niyoli zai not uiṭṭe, ar he raitta hitara kissu no fa.
Binna oi aišše, hen šomot Isaye doriyar farot tiyaiye, tarfore o sahabi okkole hiba Isade hiyan buzi no fare.
Toi Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Fuwain okkol, tũwarattu ki háibolla kissu ase?"

content: Hitara hodde, "Kissu nai."
Hibaye hitarare hodde,
Toi hitara hendilla goijje, ar eto beši mas foijje, hitara hiyan ṭani tuli no faijjil.
Toi Isaye ze sahabire ador gorito, hibaye Fitorore hodde, "Iba Malik!" Ei hota funiyore Simon Fitore gat hoor beraiye, (kiyollahoile hiba ulongo aššil) edde doriyat zaf maijje.
Ar oinno sahabi okkole mas furaiya zalgan ṭani ṭani gura not gori farot aišše, kiyollahoile hitara farottu beši dure nu aššil, onumanik dui šot hat dure aššil, hitara.
Farot lamiyore hitara dekedde, oinor hoilar ṭal ase, ar heṛe uwore hodun mas ase, edde ruṭi.
Hetunot Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ze mas ehon doijjo, hentu hougguwa ano."

content: Simon Fitore not zaiyore zalgan farot ṭani ainne, ḍõr ḍõr mase furaiya, beggune ekšo fõnzaš tinnuwa mas oiye, eto beši mas oi bade o, zalgan no síre.
Isaye hitarare hodde,
Sahabi okkol honokiye "Õne honnuwa?" fusar goitte šahoš no gore, kiyollahoile hitara zanito ze hiba Malik.
Bade Isaye ruṭi loi aiyore hitarare diye, ar he bafe mas o diye.
Morattu uṛi bade Isaye ei tisera bar sahabi okkolore deha diye.
Fitor edde Isa
Hitara beggune hána haiya šeš oi bade Isaye Simon Fitore hodde,

content.text: "Yuhannar fut Simon, itarattuwaro ki tui ãre beši ador goros?"

content: Simone hodde, "Oi, malik, õne hoi faro õne ãr hoto adoijja." Isaye hodde,
Isaye abar hodde,

content.text: "Yuhannar fut Simon, itarattuwaro ki tui ãre beši ador goros?"

content: Simone hodde, "Oi, malik, õne hoi faro õne ãr hoto adoijja." Isaye hodde,
Hibaye tisera bar Simonore hodde,

content.text: "Yuhannar fut Simon, tui ki ãre ador goros ne?"

content: Fitor ebarot dukkito oiye, kiyollahoile Isaye
tisera bar fusar goijje, ar hibare hodde, "Malik, õne hár kissu zano, õne zano ze õne ãr adoijja." Isaye hodde,

content.text: Ãi tore soiyi soiyi hoir, tui zẽtte zuwan aššili hẽtte tui nize tor kiyail banditi ar zeṛe issa heṛe zaiti, kintu zẽtte tui bura oibi hẽtte tor hat ṭanibi edde oinno ekzone tore bandibo ar tui zeṛe no zaito sos heṛe loizaibo."

content: Allar mohima forhaš goralla boli Fitor kibafe moribo hiyan dehaibolla Isaye ei hotagan hoiye. Tarfore Isaye hodde,
Fitore muk firai sadde, Isar adoijja sahabiwa o fise fise aiyer. (Iba oilde he sahabi ze hána háibar šomot Isar mikka helandiyore hoil, "Malik, õnore ze dušmonor hatot dori dibo, hiba honnuwa?")
Fitore hibare dekiyore hodde, "Malik, ibar babute ken?"
Isaye Fitorore hodde,

content.text: "Ãi zodi sai ãi abar uwafes firi no aiyi foijjonto ite zinda take, henot tor ki? Tui ãr fisa lo."

content: Hiyanor zoriya báiyain okkolor butore hóbor sorai giyegoi ze, hite no moribo; zodi o Isaye hitare no ho ze, hite no moribo; bolke hibaye hoil,

content.text: "Ãi zodi sai ãi abar uwafes firi no aiyi foijjonto ite zinda take, henot tor ki?"

content: Iba oilde he sahabi ze in beggunor babute goba der, edde in okkol hibaye leikke; ar ãra zani ze, hibar goba soiyi.
Isaye aro bout kissu goijjil; hin okkol zodi ek ekkan gori leka oito, toile edun kitab ze oito, ãi mone gorir he kitab okkol hin duniyait nu ãṛito.
